_about: Retarget of the free Quaternius Universal Animation Library (CC0) onto the Cyberwolf Sentinel. Read by scripts/tools/retarget_ual.py (same tool as Red).
clip_keys_about: Key poses of the Cyberwolf Sentinel's clips: where the strike lands (contact_s) and the poses the move data snaps to (30 fps, retarget_ual.py). Use these seconds as clip_s in moves.json anim.keys.

clips.name: idle
clips.note: Idle_Loop (Combat Designer's catalog in enemies.json behaviour.clips)

clips.name: notice
clips.note: Sword_Idle: the 'it has seen you' pose; plays once

clips.name: strafe
clips.note: same clip as walk: the name the Combat Designer's moves.json uses (body turned to face Red). strafe_l / strafe_r below are the real side-steps

clips.name: strafe_l
clips.note: walk with the hips and legs turned 90 degrees to the wolf's left (+X); torso still faces forward

clips.name: strafe_r
clips.note: walk with the hips and legs turned 90 degrees to the right

clips.name: run
clips.note: the AI's 'approach'

clips.name: retreat
clips.note: Jog played backwards (no new motion)

clips.name: stalk
clips.note: the AI's flank: low prowl

clips.name: dodge_side
clips.note: Sword_Dash first 0.6 s: the quick sidestep-slash (stretched by the move data)

clips.name: dodge_back
clips.note: Roll played backwards: a backward roll, which matches the motion away from Red

clips.name: block_start
clips.note: guard goes up

clips.name: block_hold
clips.note: guard held: Idle_Shield_Loop

clips.name: block_impact
clips.note: small shudder when a hit is blocked

clips.name: block_break
clips.note: guard broken

clips.name: attack_windup
clips.note: arm cocked high behind the head: the telegraph; it ends where attack_swing begins

clips.name: attack_swing
clips.note: claw strike across, then recovery

clips.name: hurt
clips.note: flinch A

clips.name: hurt_head
clips.note: flinch B

clips.name: stagger
clips.note: Hit_Chest slowed to 0.6x then the end pose held 2 s (the importer loops this name)

clips.name: launched
clips.note: the knock-back's mid-air pose, held 2.8 s while juggled (the importer loops this name)

clips.name: knockdown
clips.note: the fall onto the floor; ends lying down

clips.name: death
clips.note: Death01; ends lying down

proxies._about: Rough body shapes used only by --report to count frames where an arm goes through the head or the torso (the chibi proportions cause this). Head sphere, torso ellipsoid (x,z half sizes) between two bones, arm segments [from bone, to bone, start fraction].

_importer_loops_about: Clip names that scripts/tools/psx_post_import.gd (LOOPING_CLIPS) loops whatever the file says; the key data lists them as loops.
